01 / THE PROBLEM

Why build it?

Small aerial objects are difficult to detect consistently across scale, motion, and changing backgrounds. A usable interface also needs to communicate tracking context.

02 / THE IMPLEMENTATION

How it fits together.

The repository combines YOLO11 detection, SAHI sliced inference, and DeepSORT tracking. It includes telemetry calculations, a web dashboard, and sample processed video. This showcase focuses on detection and visualization.

  • Sliced inference for small-object detection
  • Multi-object tracking and visual telemetry
  • Dashboard and recorded evidence workflow
Project context

Recorded repository demo. Geographic estimates depend on calibration and assumptions; this page makes no deployment-grade accuracy claim.
